scope: GitHub integration, page saving, SEO readiness and source security

features.stars: GET /api/github, fixed public repository, no token, 15-minute single-flight cache, 3-second upstream deadline, 4 KiB response limit, retry backoff and existing bounded metadata limiter
features.starAction: opens GitHub; starring uses the visitor account
features.save: native share menu when supported; canonical link copy; browser bookmark instructions; no user files shared
features.fallback: unsupported browser targets reset and visible server-unavailable message with correct 20 MB limit

limits: Browser viewport checks are not physical iPhone tests.
A successful fixture is not proof for all arbitrary files.
Sitemap readiness does not guarantee search-engine indexing.
Source scanning cannot guarantee absence of every secret or vulnerability.
Starring directly inside this site would require visitor GitHub authorization; no visitor OAuth tokens are collected.
